issues.title: Preserve exported note fidelity
issues.body:
# CSV fidelity bug

## Why this matters
Downstream importers need the original note bytes. Whitespace must not be stripped.

## Agreed behavior
Export columns stay id,note in that order. Preserve notes exactly, including =SUM(A1:A2), CRLF inside quoted fields, commas, quotes and Unicode. Empty export still contains the header. No spreadsheet escaping: this is a machine-transfer format, not a spreadsheet-safe export.

## Delivery checks
Add round-trip tests using the public CLI with csv.DictReader, covering these notes and empty input. Existing tests/test_exports.py must stay green. Python stdlib runner in factory/sandbox.Dockerfile is sufficient; no network, credentials or new packages are needed. Inspect next at 535ea303798d255b29d3bced5bccc673424d4dd2.

## Exclusions
No UI changes, new columns, format switch or live importer qualification.

Prepared by an external contributor; preserve the wording and organization when preparing this issue.

import csv
def export_rows(rows, destination):
    writer=csv.writer(destination)
    writer.writerow(["id", "note"])
    writer.writerows((row["id"], row["note"]) for row in rows)
readiness_repository_files.recordtools/__main__.py:
import csv,sys
from . import export_rows
with open(sys.argv[1],newline="") as source, open(sys.argv[2],"w",newline="") as destination:
    export_rows(list(csv.DictReader(source)), destination)

import json,urllib.request
def deliver(url, message, token):
    request=urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({"text":message}).encode(), headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token,"Content-Type":"application/json"}, method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=3) as response:
        return response.status
